title: drymocallis wrangelliana
intro: Drymocallis wrangelliana, commonly known as Wrangell's cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Wrangell's cinquefoil include its ability to reduce pain, alleviate digestive issues, and support immune function. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
